To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a comprehensive approach to CNF education requires the following.
computer and network forensic education should focus on the application of science and technology to the investigation of computer related crime.
a computer forensics curriculum is best taught in a multidisciplinary environment that includes a mix of computer science and law enforcement professionals.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of computer and network forensic techniques and the training of personnel to implement those techniques in a variety of contexts.

the application of science and edu cation to computer related crime investigation and forensics, which we define as the application of computer and network science and technology to the analysis of digital evidence for legal purposes.
the development of a pedagogical model for a computer forensics curriculum.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the computer forensics field is the application of scientific methods and procedures to the identification, collection, examination, analysis, and presentation of digital evidence.
computer forensics is an investigative process that seeks to preserve and analyze digital evidence in order to establish the facts in a computer related crime, or civil dispute.

the computer and network forensic discipline is the application of scientific methods to the identification, collection, examination, and analysis of digital evidence for the purpose of facilitating or furthering the reconstruction of events found to be criminal, or helping to anticipate unauthorized actions shown to be disruptive to planned operations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are trying to create a model for the education of forensic scientists. We are not trying to teach people how to be computer forensic scientists, but how to become one.
computer and network forensic techniques are needed to support the growing field of digital evidence.

computer forensics is a field that has evolved from a single, narrow, law enforcement focused discipline into a multi faceted and interdisciplinary one, and it is growing rapidly as a field of study. 2
The main takeaway from our work is that
computer forensics is a discipline that is rapidly evolving.
computer forensics is an important area of study for computer scientists.
the computer forensic community needs a comprehensive, interdisciplinary, and collaborative effort to create and disseminate a usable pedagogic model.
